results.title: Regulatory Activities
results.content: For each regulatory activity an entity **must**have policy authority from Government (Cabinet or the Prime Minister) to charge, including the level of charge (full or partial recovery of costs). When assessing the potential to charge, for new or existing government activities or when making changes to the level of a charge, entity staff should conduct appropriate research and analysis, including stakeholders’ consultations. The regular CRA review which supports the annual CRIS review process is expected to be a part of entities internal risk management process, and unless that review indicates overall high rating there is no need to consult the existing activity CRA with finance.However, where the change is to the policy authority, legislation or there are significant changes to the charge activity, Finance and the entity should agree a rating and/or recommend further consideration by government. A Commonwealth entity must report on an aggregate level the financial information of cost recovery in the entity’s annual financial statements, in accordance with the Public Governance, Performance and Accountability (Financial Reporting) Rule 2015 (FRR).
